title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 2 — Unified Verified Data Repair
problem: CFB Game Total Page 2 renders already-owned matchup evidence as unavailable across pace, explosive/YPP, red-zone, defense and trends because the Page-2 display schema is flatter than the evidence Page 1 already loaded.
root_cause: The first unified adapter fixed the schema mismatch but could reopen Runtime Snapshot, Step-5 and Step-6 provider work from the interactive Page-2 render path. That made valid data recovery capable of blocking the page on synchronous provider timeouts and violated the declared zero-new-network-call boundary.
patch: Activate a small V2 presentation bridge at the existing same-page seam. V2 consumes only evidence already loaded by Page 1, maps official plays-per-game and yards-per-play rows into Page-2 pace/explosive fields, maps verified red-zone score rate into the existing red_zone_rate display alias, preserves explicit recent points-allowed aggregates for defense, normalizes score-only completed-game rows for trends, preserves only already-verified half/quarter splits, and performs zero provider HTTP from Page 2. The original fetch-capable adapter remains non-authoritative and is no longer on the active render path.
